prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high for neutral or negative changes, but too low for winning tests.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect in 2 tests and made performance worse in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made performance worse in 1 test and showed no clear effect in 1 test.
Sign-in reorder changes were helpful in 1 test, while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path reorder and sign_in notification (1 test each), while adoption new_flow had mixed results across 2 tests (1 worse, 1 won).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -4.2% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +8.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Deferred To Post-Waiting Stage: Move the sign-in step to occur right after the waiting screen before entering the home intro, allowing users to experience pet creation before registering. (why: Sign-in reorder changes previously showed positive impact in testing, and delaying account creation lowers friction during initial onboarding.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Persona Carousel Redesign: Redesign the pet choice screen into an interactive full-bleed carousel showing animated pet behaviors and trait cards. (why: Adoption step has 71.7% conversion with high median time (89s); standard grid choices create hesitation.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Value Proposition Copy: Clarify the differences between adopting a standard pet and generating a custom pet with direct path outcome descriptions. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path, spending an average of 514s trying to decide between onboarding paths.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Sync Safety Hint: Add a reassurance hint explaining that signing in restores previous pets and preserves desktop settings across devices. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, causing user anxiety during login.)
4: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Processing Duration Estimate Notice: Display estimated processing time and real-time status cues when uploading custom pet photos. (why: Adoption step has high drop-off (71.7% conversion) and long mean completion time (1017s) due to photo uploading.)
5: [home, notification] Pet Ready Desktop Push Notification: Enable a system notification that alerts the user when pet generation finishes if they switch away from the app. (why: Users spend a median of 201s and mean of 2336s on the waiting screen, leading to lost engagement.)
6: [finish, layout] Home Intro Split Guidance Layout: Reframe home intro screen using a two-column layout highlighting pet care quick actions alongside desktop shortcut keys. (why: Finish step has only 64.8% completion rate and users report post-onboarding confusion regarding controls.)

scores.note: Sign-in reordering showed mild positive impact (+1.0%) in previous tests.
Adoption redesigns consistently underperformed or worsened conversion (-4.2%).
Config-only copy change targeting moderate drop-off and high completion time on choose_path.
Strong evidence from support emails; simple config hint reduces sign-in friction.
Addresses high adoption drop-off (71.7%) and long mean completion time (1017s).
Push notifications help re-engage users during long home generation wait times (mean 2336s).
Finish step has high drop-off, but screen/layout modifications historically hurt conversion (-2.0%).
